name: list_entries
description:
Lists Entries within a specific Entry Group in the Knowledge Catalog (formerly known as Dataplex).

Entry Groups are logical groupings of Entries, including:
- System Entry Groups managed by Google Cloud services, such as `@bigquery` (BigQuery datasets, tables, views, routines, models), `@pubsub` (Pub/Sub topics), and `@dataplex` (Data Products, Business Glossaries, Terms).
- Custom Entry Groups created by users or third-party integrations (such as dbt projects).

**When to use `list_entries` vs `search_entries`**:
- Use **`search_entries`** for broad discovery across an organization or projects using natural language queries or cross-group predicates.
- Use **`list_entries`** when you already know the target `entry_group_id` (in a specific `project_id` and `location`) and want to enumerate its Entries or filter them by `entry_type`, `entry_source.display_name`, or `parent_entry` (for example, listing tables inside a specific BigQuery dataset or listing dbt models in a custom dbt Entry Group).

parameters.description: List Entries request in the simplified MCP format.

entryGroupId.description: Required. The ID of the parent Entry Group whose Entries are to be listed (for example, `@bigquery` for BigQuery resources, `@pubsub` for Pub/Sub topics, `@dataplex` for Dataplex resources, or a custom Entry Group ID such as `dbt-jaffle-shop`).

filter.description: Optional. A case-sensitive filter on the Entries to return. Supported filter fields: - `entry_type` - `entry_source.display_name` - `parent_entry` Comparison operators: `=`, `!=`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=` (lexical order). Logical operators: `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`. Wildcard `*` is supported, but `entry_type` and `parent_entry` require the full project ID or number. `parent_entry` cannot be combined with other fields. Examples: ## - `entry_source.display_name=orders` ## `entry_type=projects/dataplex-types/locations/global/entryTypes/bigquery-table` `parent_entry=projects/my-project/locations/us/entryGroups/@bigquery/entries/bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/my-project/datasets/my_dataset`

location.description: Required. The Google Cloud location (region or `global`) of the Entry Group (e.g., `us-central1`, `us`, or `global`).

pageSize.description: Optional. Number of Entries to return per page. If there are remaining results, the service returns a `next_page_token`. If unspecified, the service returns at most 10 Entries. The maximum value is 100; values above 100 will be coerced to 100.

pageToken.description: Optional. Page token received from a previous `ListEntries` call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.

projectId.description: Required. The project ID to which the request should be attributed and which contains the Entry Group.
